name: default
description: Multi-tenant zone cache for the SaaS home zone (e.g. skyphusionwp.dev), where one zone terminates MANY tenant hostnames (CR #18, issue #201 Phase 1). Difference from the dedicated ruleset: the cache rule is NOT keyed to one hostname; it matches a tenant-host expression (@CACHE_EXPR@, substituted by apply.sh MODE=multitenant). Tenant pages are kept apart by Cloudflare's DEFAULT cache key, which already includes the Host (scheme + host + URI). We deliberately set NO custom cache key: the custom host cache-key component is Enterprise-only and would be redundant here. ORDER MATTERS: last match wins for set_cache_settings, so the bypass rule is LAST and overrides the cache rule for any dynamic/session request.

rules.description: Cache anonymous HTML for tenant hosts at the edge (origin is the Worker). @CACHE_EXPR@ scopes this to the tenant hostnames and MUST exclude the control-plane / apex host. First rule; the bypass below overrides it for any dynamic/session request (last match wins). Tenants stay isolated via the default Host-inclusive cache key.

Bypass cache for admin, auth, API (including the ?rest_route= alias and ?wc-ajax=), cron, the operator /_ paths, any request carrying an Authorization header, comment posts, invoices, cart/checkout/account, any logged-in / password / preferences / comment-author / WooCommerce (incl. wp_woocommerce_session) cookie, and any non-GET method. LAST rule: on a request that also matched the cache rule above, this cache:false wins (last match wins). Host-agnostic, so it protects every tenant.
rules.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-admin")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-login")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-json")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-cron")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cart")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/checkout")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/my-account")) or (http.cookie contains "wordpress_logged_in") or (http.cookie contains "wp-postpass") or (http.cookie contains "wp-settings") or (http.cookie contains "comment_author") or (http.cookie contains "woocommerce_") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_")) or (any(http.request.headers.names[*] == "authorization")) or (http.request.uri.query contains "rest_route=") or (http.request.uri.query contains "wc-ajax=") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-comments-post")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/skyphusion-invoice")) or (http.request.method ne "GET")
